help: usage: fleet-switchboard remind [-h] [--list] [--cancel ID] [--key KEY] [--keep-if-closed] [--issue ISSUE] [--from SENDER] [--until-closed OWNER/REPO#N] [--until-merged OWNER/REPO#N] [name] [when] [text ...] positional arguments: name The recipient's fleet name when A delay (30m, 2h, 1d) or an ISO time with a zone text The reminder options: -h, --help show this help message and exit --list Show your own pending reminders (id, time, recipient, issue, text) --cancel ID Cancel one of your pending reminders by its id (see --list) --key KEY Name the purpose: arming again with the same key replaces your pending reminder of that key. --keep-if-closed With --issue: deliver even if that issue has been closed (by default a reminder about an issue is dropped, unsent, once the issue is closed) --issue ISSUE The issue the reminder is about --from SENDER Lab only: the sender's fleet name --until-closed OWNER/REPO#N Drop the reminder, unsent, once this issue (or pull request) is closed or merged --until-merged OWNER/REPO#N Drop the reminder, unsent, once this pull request is merged
